films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's Medusa — snake-haired, bow-armed in her temple — fixed the Gorgon for modern screens.

popCulture.title: Medusa
popCulture.description: The mortal Gorgon whose glance turns flesh to stone — Perseus' trophy and Western art's most recycled monster.

popCulture.title: Gorgon
popCulture.description: Stheno, Euryale, and Medusa — the winged sisters whose faces guarded temples long before Perseus came.
